import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to features with significant association (p < 0.05)
    sig_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) 
                   if feats.types[i] != 'clinical' and 
                      abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1], 
                                          feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0])[0]) > 2.0]
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if len(sig_features) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr_pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in [
        ('DZQJ1B','IWXU3'), ('WXF10','QTLM17'), ('WXF10','WZOP11'), ('VBAT15B','WZOP11'),
        ('ZJC5','IWXU3'), ('WZOP11','QTLM17'), ('BGCQ3','QTLM17'), ('IWXU3','QTLM17'),
        ('GAE11','WXF10'), ('ZJC5','DZQJ1B'), ('ZJC5','QTLM17'), ('GAE11','QTLM17'),
        ('HMQJ7','QTLM17'), ('XKXG6','QTLM17'), ('WXF10','BGCQ3'), ('LRK17B','QTLM17'),
        ('IDH14','QTLM17'), ('ZJC5','SOJ4'), ('HMQJ7','YTN8A'), ('XKXG6','IWXU3')
    ] if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids]
    
    # Build adjacency matrix
    adj = np.zeros((len(feats.ids), len(feats.ids)))
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        ia, ib = feats.column(a), feats.column(b)
        adj[ia, ib] = adj[ib, ia] = 1
    
    # Cluster features using hierarchical clustering
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2, linkage='average')
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - adj)
    
    # Find the largest cluster (module)
    if len(set(cluster_labels)) == 1:
        module = sig_features
    else:
        largest_cluster = max(set(cluster_labels), key=lambda c: sum(1 for l in cluster_labels if l == c))
        module = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) if cluster_labels[i] == largest_cluster]
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    module_effects = [(fid, abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1], 
                                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0])[0])) 
                     for fid in module if fid in feats.ids]
    module_effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    module = [fid for fid, _ in module_effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Calculate weighted score (mean of selected features)
    weights = {}
    for fid in module:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, col_idx][feats.y==1], 
                                feats.x[:, col_idx][feats.y==0])[0]
        weights[fid] = t_stat / len(module)
    
    # Return design with module members and their loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple([fid for fid in module if fid in feats.ids]),
        columns=tuple([fid for fid in module if fid in feats.ids]),
        products=(),
        loadings=weights
    )
